membership: Current authority and [joined_at, left_at) gate every read and command. History is restricted to the current membership interval. Listing, opening and status admit currently authorized blocked members for block management without exposing messages or receipts.
privacy: No message body, contact field, evidence reference or report reason enters an event, notification envelope or log. Pre-sale previews mask recognizable contacts. Delivery fields require current paid-held authority.
retry: After a lost reply reconcile the same operation; one retry uses identical bytes. Conflicting reuse denies. Current access is rechecked before returning a receipt. Blocked members may recover only their own committed block receipt; messages and other receipts remain restricted.
revision: New commands require current thread and source revisions. An identical committed retry returns its original receipt after current access checks.
